chapter: Washington, New Orleans and the road
title: Resembling his mother; his father killed by a train
summary: Turner looks like his mother; his father, a hotel cook, was killed by a train when Turner was five or six.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: You were just telling me that you look more like your mother than your father. Is that right?
Yeah. Only I'm not as light as my mother.
But your features are more like your mother.
Your father was a cook in a hotel in Kansas City. Is that right?
And he was killed in an accident?

Yeah, he was killed by a train. Goin' fishin'. He was goin' out by this Forrest Park, a big park they got in Kansas City. Train was comin' on one side. 'Nother train was comin' on the other track. He stepped offa one...offa one track t' git off...outa the way an' stepped right into another train.
Ohhhhh... That was when you were fifteen? Is that right?
Oh, that was a long time ago. I guess I was about five or six years old.
I thought that's what...what you had told me but I read in a...in a book or magazine that you were older. I didn't think that was right. You were about five or six when that happened, huh?
Yeah, I was a young kid then.
